bilbo_baggins.name: Bilbo Baggins
bilbo_baggins.title: Son of Bungo
bilbo_baggins.bio: Bilbo Baggins was a Hobbit who lived in The Shire during the final years of the Third Age. His adventure with the dwarves Thorin and Company earned him a fortune, and brought the One Ring of Sauron back into knowledge.
